finalText:
Build's clean. Two bugs from the bump:

First, `options.js` was looking for `options.retries` but the new bundler passes `options.retryCount`. Second, `retryPolicy.js` threw when it saw `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Changed the throw to return false.

The warnings you're seeing are deprecation noise from the bumped packages — those are real but can't be fixed in your code. The actual bugs are gone.
